title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: The smile on that person's face grew increasingly sinister: "The Chen family's little whelp, the debt your father owed back then should be repaid by you today."

text.content: The morning mist had yet to disperse as Chen Ji stood outside the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, his robes fluttering violently in the mountain wind. That face, so identical to Su Qingyao's, still lingered in his mind like a fine needle piercing his heart, each heartbeat tugging at a faint ache. He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the chaotic thoughts—there were more pressing matters at hand. An urgent report had come from the Sect Mission Hall: abnormal fluctuations had been detected near the Spiritual Mine in Qingmu Town, requiring someone to investigate. This should have been an unimportant task. After the Fifth Elder's faction fell, his days had finally grown peaceful, yet he hadn't expected such brief tranquility. He didn't wish to pursue this path, yet fate seemed to push him forward relentlessly.

dialogue.content: "A servant disciple dares to take on an external assignment? Your courage has certainly grown." A sarcastic voice came from behind.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't turn around, merely curling his lips into a barely perceptible arc. The speaker was an Inner Disciple, a sycophant who had once依附 Fifth Elder. Now that his master had fallen, he'd tucked his tail between his legs. Chen Ji had never bothered to entertain such small characters' cold ridicule. Turning to step onto the stone stairs leading down the mountain, Chen Ji's divine consciousness spread quietly, alert to every movement around him. For some unknown reason, an indistinct sense of unease lingered in his heart, as if some danger was watching from the shadows. He attributed this feeling to the aftereffects of that face, unaware that this intuition would unknowingly save his life.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" A domineering voice came from behind, accompanied by a wave of scorching heat. Han Lie descended through the air, landing not far in front of Chen Ji, his eyes full of provocation, "That Qingmu Town mission, I'll take it. If you know what's good for you, get back to sweeping your floors."

text.content: Chen Ji didn't slow his steps, passing Han Lie as if the latter were merely an unremarkable stone by the roadside. Han Lie's expression darkened; he reached out to block the way, only to find that Chen Ji wouldn't even give him a direct glance. That expressionless face clearly displayed four characters—utter disdain. "You're courting death!" A flash of anger appeared in Han Lie's eyes. The Xuanwu Sect's techniques rapidly circulated within his body, the scorching aura distorting the surrounding air. However, just as he prepared to strike, a sword light descended from the heavens, carving a deep trench between the two.

dialogue.content: "Sect grounds, private combat forbidden." Su Qingyao's figure emerged from the clouds and mist. That cold as frost face made Chen Ji's heart tighten. She swept her gaze across the two confronting figures, pausing briefly on Chen Ji's face, seeming to sense something, yet saying nothing more, "Both may go on the Qingmu Town mission. Whoever completes it first claims the credit."

text.content: Chen Ji slightly cupped his fists to Su Qingyao, neither servile nor overbearing, then turned to continue walking down the mountain. His figure vanished into the morning mist, leaving Su Qingyao with an unfathomable mystery. Behind him, Han Lie snorted coldly and stepped onto the transmission array, preparing to compete with Chen Ji. Yet Su Qingyao stood frozen in place, her brow slightly furrowed, lost in thought. Upon leaving the sect's barrier, Chen Ji sensed an indistinct killing intent permeating the air. His expression unchanged, he continued forward, secretly expanding his divine sense to its absolute limit.

Passing through a dense forest, Chen Ji suddenly stopped. Ahead, on both sides of the Mountain Path, ancient trees towered, their branches and leaves interlocking into a dark green dome, fragmenting the morning sunlight into mottled shards. The surroundings were eerily silent; even insect chirps and bird calls had vanished, leaving only the rustling sound of wind through leaves. His eyes slightly hardened, alarm bells ringing in his heart—this silence was too deliberate, as if an invisible net was quietly tightening. Almost instinctively, he shifted half a step to the right, and a black arrow whistled past his ear, embedding deep into the rock behind him.

dialogue.content: "Since you're already here, why skulk about like a ghost." Chen Ji's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone present, "Lurking in the shadows shooting cold arrows—hardly the conduct of a hero." Before his words even finished, dense footsteps echoed from the surrounding woods. Over a dozen black-clothed figures emerged simultaneously from all directions, completely surrounding him. These people wore black masks and moved in uniform precision. The weakest among them had reached late-stage Foundation Building, while three radiated the aura of Golden Core realm.

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally landing on the leader. The figure was tall and imposing, wearing a silver mask that revealed only a pair of sinister eyes. He gripped a black halberd, and the imposing aura he exuded far surpassed everyone else present—clearly the mastermind of this assassin squad. "Chen Ji, Tianqing Sect servant disciple." The man's voice was hoarse and ice-cold, "Someone paid a high price for your life. Will you surrender yourself, or shall we make you?"

choice.prompt: Facing encirclement by a dozen assassins, Chen Ji needed to make a choice

choices.description: Respond to the assassins' encirclement with force, proving through strength that he is no ordinary person. This might expose more of his abilities, but could intimidate the enemies.
choices.visible_reward: Battle reputation increases, position in Tianqing Sect stabilizes
choices.risk_hint: May expose too much strength, drawing more attention

text.content: The corner of Chen Ji's lips lifted slightly; that smile appeared sinister and dangerous to the assassins. "Surrender?" he repeated softly, his tone full of mockery, "With just you little fishes, am I supposed to surrender?" Before the words even finished, his aura suddenly surged. His cultivation, suppressed to its absolute limit, erupted like a breached dam, that oppressive might actually not inferior to any Golden Core expert present.

dialogue.content: "Impossible! You're clearly only a..." The masked leader's pupils contracted sharply, his voice betraying undisguised shock.

choices.description: Use terrain and wisdom to create an escape opportunity, avoiding direct confrontation with enemies. Preserve strength, avoid prematurely revealing trump cards.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve trump cards, investigate the mastermind behind the scenes in secret
choices.risk_hint: May be considered weak and easily bullied

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered; he already had a plan. He appeared to stumble backward in panic, yet in his hand, he'd quietly crushed a jade talisman hidden in his sleeve. This was one of the protective measures Mo Xiansheng had left him—the Misleading Footprint Talisman. In an instant, a faint white mist diffused through the surrounding air, enveloping the entire forest. The assassins' vision was severely impaired, their originally tight encirclement formation instantly showing cracks.

dialogue.content: "Trying to flee?" The masked man coldly snorted, his halberd slicing out a fierce halberd light directly toward Chen Ji's position, "Playing tricks like this before me? How naive of you!"

choices.description: In a critical moment, activate the Tianji Record to foresee events within the next three hours, gaining crucial combat advantage, but consuming 5 points of Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate, may alert Mo Xiansheng to abnormalities
choices.visible_reward: Gain future foresight, secure absolute first-mover advantage in battle
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption will affect future foresight abilities

text.content: Just as that lethal strike was about to land, a strange light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. His right hand secretly formed a seal, and the Tianji Record Fragment within his body quivered slightly. An incomparably profound force instantly flooded his divine sense. In that instant, time seemed to slow; everything around became crystal clear—the assassins' every movement, every breath, even the flow of spiritual energy in the air, all lay before his eyes. He saw everything that would happen in the next three breaths.

dialogue.content: "So that's how it is." A knowing smile curved Chen Ji's lips. His figure ghostly shifted a mere half-inch, barely dodging the lethal blow, while his reverse palm slammed into the ambusher's chest, sending them flying several zhang away.

text.content: Chen Ji穿梭 in bizarre footsteps through the assassin group. Each dodge precisely avoided lethal strikes; each counterattack precisely struck the enemies' vitals. His movements appeared fluid and natural, yet every step was precisely calculated by the Tianji Record. However, such high-intensity combat placed too heavy a burden on a servant disciple like him. In merely moments, beads of sweat already glistened on his forehead. "This approach won't work." He pondered silently, his gaze sweeping across the surroundings, searching for a breakthrough.

dialogue.content: "Hahaha! Chen Ji, this is your comeuppance!" At this moment, a domineering voice rang out from afar, accompanied by a wave of scorching heat. Han Lie strode through the void, his Xuanwu Sect techniques pushed to their extreme, resembling a war god bathed in flames. He clearly came to snatch credit. Now seeing Chen Ji surrounded, far from offering help, he instead stood aside to enjoy the show, "The堂堂 Tianqing Sect servant disciple, actually being chased by a few assassins—truly humiliating!"

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at Han Lie, his heart coldly amused. The Xuanwu Sect's genius was indeed as foolish as the rumors suggested. Choosing to stand by at such a moment—once he was dead or severely injured, the credit would naturally fall to Han Lie. Yet this was also good; he could use these assassins to probe Han Lie's bottom line. He deliberately shifted the battlefield toward Han Lie's direction, shouting loudly: "Since Young Master Han has come, why not lend a hand? Must you watch眼睁睁 as I'm killed by these unidentified people?"

choice.prompt: Han Lie's appearance complicated the situation further. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Use words to刺激 Han Lie, forcing him to join the battle, achieving借刀杀人 (using another's blade to kill).
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie is forced to fight, situation reverses
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie doesn't take the bait, will fall into greater crisis

text.content: The corner of Chen Ji唇角 lifted in a mocking arc, his voice clearly reaching everyone present: "The Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, turns out to be just a coward watching the show. If I die here, where does Han Lie's face go? Where does the face of the three great sects go?" This speech was extremely heart-piercing, clearly putting Han Lie on the spot.

dialogue.content: "What did you say!" Han Lie predictably took the bait, his face flushing crimson red, his surrounding aura surging to a terrifying level, "I, Han Lie, the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, am I someone who fears death! These assassins, I'll handle them!"

choices.description: Pay no attention to Han Lie, continue focusing on breaking through the assassin encirclement, preserving one's own plan from disruption.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to借刀杀人
choices.visible_reward: Maintain complete control over the situation

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, no longer even glancing at Han Lie, as if the latter were merely an unimportant passerby. This feeling of being completely ignored enraged Han Lie, yet he simply couldn't find a reason to flare up. He coldly snorted, about to turn and leave, when the assassin squad's leader suddenly spoke.

dialogue.content: "Xuanwu Sect person?" The masked man's voice carried a hint of playfulness, "Interesting. It seems today's harvest exceeds my expectations."

text.content: As both sides remained at a stalemate, the masked man suddenly burst into laughter. That laughter echoed through the silent forest, sounding particularly eerie. He slowly walked toward Chen Ji, his black halberd carving a deep trench along the ground. Each step carried a suffocating pressure. "Chen Ji, do you know why we want to kill you?" His voice suddenly turned low and complex, "Do you think this is simply a case of being hired? How naive you are."

dialogue.content: "Speak plainly if you have something to say. No need for roundabout remarks." Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, yet a strange restlessness surged within his heart. He had an intuition that what this assassin leader was about to say might completely change his understanding of many things.

text.content: The masked man stopped before Chen Ji, his silver mask gleaming coldly in the mottled light and shadow. He slowly raised his hand and removed the silver mask, revealing a face chiseled as if carved by knife and axe—a resolute countenance. It was a weathered face, bearing too many marks of the years, yet those eyes remained sharp as blades, seemingly able to see through all pretense in the world. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji's face, churning with too many complex emotions—hatred, resentment, yet also carrying an indefinable nostalgia.

dialogue.content: "The Chen family's little whelp." The man suddenly spoke, his voice hoarse and low, yet carrying a strange tremor, "You should have resembled your father more. Pity. He died too early, never got to see you grow up." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply; his heart felt as if gripped by an invisible hand. Father? This person knew his father? He forced himself to remain calm, yet his voice slightly tightened: "Who exactly are you?" The man's lips curled into a cold smile, that smile brimming with venom and mockery: "Who am I? The blood debt your father owed back then—today, you'll repay it."

text.content: With those words, Chen Ji felt his mind explode with a thunderous roar. Countless questions flooded in like a tide. Blood debt his father owed? What blood debt? Didn't his father die in an ordinary accident? What exactly was hidden in all this? In that instant, that face so identical to Su Qingyao's appeared in his mind again, overlapping with the assassin leader's face before him, sending a bone-deep chill through his heart. If all this was connected, then what role did Su Qingyao play in this? What did his years of trust in her mean? The mountain wind howled, stirring up fallen leaves across the ground. In this tense moment, an untimely voice suddenly echoed from afar—"Chen Ji! Are you still alive!" It was Su Qingyao's voice, cold yet carrying a hint of undetectable urgency. Chen Ji raised his head, gazing toward where the voice originated, his eyes deep and unfathomable.
